gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the feeder case a Blink owner would use (Wasserstein, $47.99 on 2026-11-17) comes with no close-focus lens, and that Digital Camera World found a security camera in it could not focus on birds that close. The $39.99 Wyze Bird Feeder does include a magnifying lens, but it fits only Wyze cameras, and the Birdfy Feeder sells for $99.99 with its own camera.
standout_why: I compared against the cited Wyze support pages (24/7 local recording, v3 continuous recording) and Blink support pages (Local Storage with Sync Module, Blink Storage Options). They cover recording without a subscription but say nothing about focus or about what each route costs. Uncited result #29 (Wyze, 'How does Wyze Bird Feeder take clear up-close bird pictures') gives the 4–8 in focus range of the Wyze lens. No result says the Blink route has no close-focus fix, no result gives any price, and PopSci (2023) has no 2026 prices. ChatGPT's answer only told the shopper to 'test the focus distance'.
decides: For a Wyze owner it confirms the pick: the $39.99 Wyze Bird Feeder with its included magnifying lens, recording to microSD with no plan. For a Blink owner it changes the advice. The $47.99 Wasserstein case plus a Sync Module 2 and a USB drive still has no close-focus lens, so photos will be soft. That build costs about half of a $99.99 Birdfy Feeder that has its own camera, so a Blink owner who wants sharp bird photos may be better served by a dedicated feeder.
